To analyse the biomass within meta-ecosystems in our experiment, we require a dataset where each row represents a connected or unconnected meta-ecosystem at a specific time point (`ds_metaecosystems`). To do so, we need to identify which ecosystems to combine in unconnected & connected meta-ecosystems (storing combinations in `ecosystem_combinations)` and then sum the biomass of combined ecosystems (from `ds_ecosystems`) into `ds_metaecosytems` by going through the following steps. (1) Identify the combinations of ecosystems that constitute connected meta-ecosystems. This allows us to know the biomass of which ecosystems to sum. (2) Determine the ecosystem IDs of unconnected ecosystems. This allows us to then create unconnected meta-ecosystems. (3) Identify the combinations of ecosystems that constitute unconnected meta-ecosystems. This allows us to know the biomass of which ecosystems to sum. (4) Bind connected and unconnected meta-ecosystem combinations. (5) Create ds_metaecosystems.

```{r identify-combinations-connected-ecos}

# --- IDENTIFY ECOSYSTEM COMBINATIONS THAT CONSTITUTE CONNECTED META-ECOSYSTEMS --- #

combinations_connected = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(
    
         # To have the information about to which system nr and metaecosystem type 
         # each ecosystem belongs, we select one of the time points to don't have 
         # multiple information of the same ecosystem.
         
         time_point == 0,
         
         # To create only combinations for connected metaecosystems, 
         # we filter the combinations of only connected ecosystems
         
         connection == "connected") %>%
  select(system_nr,
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ecosystem_ID) %>%
    
  # To know which ecosystems were combined to for the connected 
  # meta-ecosystem, assign the ecosystem ID to the first and second 
  # ecosystems as mean ± 0.5. This is because the two ecosystems of a 
  # meta-ecosystem are two integers next to each other (e.g., 31 and 32). 
  
  group_by(system_nr,
           ecosystem_size_ml,
           connection,
           disturbance_percentage) %>%
  summarise(ID_first_ecosystem = (mean(ecosystem_ID) - 0.5),
            ID_second_ecosystem = (mean(ecosystem_ID) + 0.5)) %>%
  mutate(ecosystems_combined = paste0(ID_first_ecosystem, 
                                      "|", 
                                      ID_second_ecosystem)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r identify-combinations-unconnected-ecos}

# --- IDENTIFY THE COMBINATIONS OF ECOSYSTEMS THAT CONSTITUTE UNCONNECTED META-ECOSYSTEMS --- #

# Determine ecosystems IDs of unconnected autotrophic ecosystems

ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_autotrophic_fixed = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 6.43,
         trophic_type == "autotrophic",
         connection == "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage == "fixed") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%
  unique()

ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 9.00,

ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed = ds_ecosystems %>%

         disturbance_percentage == "fixed") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%

ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_autotrophic_relative = ds_ecosystems %>%

         connection == "unconnected",

  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 6.43,
         trophic_type == "heterotrophic",
         connection == "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage == "fixed") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%

  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 9.00,

         connection == "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage == "fixed") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%

ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_heterotrophic_fixed = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 15.00,

         connection == "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage == "fixed") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%
  unique()

ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_heterotrophic_fixed = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 45.00,
         trophic_type == "heterotrophic",
         connection == "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage == "fixed") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%
  unique()

ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_heterotrophic_relative = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 6.43,

         disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size") %>%
  pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%

ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml == 9.00,

# Find combinations

combinations_6.43_ml_fixed = crossing(ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_autotrophic_fixed,
                                      ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_heterotrophic_fixed) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 6.43,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "fixed") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_autotrophic_fixed,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_heterotrophic_fixed) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,

         disturbance_percentage,

         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_9.00_ml_fixed = crossing(ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed,

  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 9.00,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "fixed") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_heterotrophic_fixed) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_15.00_ml_fixed = crossing(ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed,
                                       ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_heterotrophic_fixed) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 15.00,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "fixed") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed,

  select(ecosystem_size_ml,

         disturbance_percentage,

         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_45.00_ml_fixed = crossing(ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed,
                                       ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_heterotrophic_fixed) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 45.00,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "fixed") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_autotrophic_fixed,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_heterotrophic_fixed) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_6.43_ml_relative = crossing(ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_autotrophic_relative,
                                         ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 6.43,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "decreasing_with_size") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_autotrophic_relative,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_6.43_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_9.00_ml_relative = crossing(ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_autotrophic_relative,
                                         ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 9.00,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "decreasing_with_size") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_autotrophic_relative,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_9.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_15.00_ml_relative = crossing(ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_autotrophic_relative,
                                          ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 15.00,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "decreasing_with_size") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_autotrophic_relative,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_15.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_45.00_ml_relative = crossing(ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_autotrophic_relative,
                                          ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_size_ml = 45.00,
         connection = "unconnected",
         disturbance_percentage = "decreasing_with_size") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_autotrophic_relative,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_45.00_ml_heterotrophic_relative) %>%
  select(ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

# Bind combinations

combinations_unconnected = rbind(combinations_6.43_ml_fixed,
                                 combinations_9.00_ml_fixed,
                                 combinations_15.00_ml_fixed,
                                 combinations_45.00_ml_fixed,
                                 combinations_6.43_ml_relative,
                                 combinations_9.00_ml_relative,
                                 combinations_15.00_ml_relative,
                                 combinations_45.00_ml_relative) %>%
  
  # To have a system nr for all the unconnected meta-ecosystems, give them a 
  # nr that starts from 1000, so that they can be distinguished 
  # from the connected meta-ecosystems. 
  
  mutate(system_nr = 1001:(1000 + nrow(.)),
         ecosystems_combined = paste0(ID_first_ecosystem, "|", 
                                      ID_second_ecosystem)) %>%
  select(system_nr,
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem,
         ecosystems_combined)
```

```{r join-combinations-connected-and-unconnected-ecos}

# --- BIND CONNECTED AND UNCONNECTED META-ECOSYSTEM COMBINATIONS --- #

ecosystem_combinations = rbind(combinations_connected,
                               combinations_unconnected)
```

```{r create-ds_metaecosystems}

# --- USE ECOSYSTEM COMBINATIONS TO CREATE DS_METAECOSYSTEMS --- #

# Set parameters

row_i = 0

# Create ds_metaecosystems

for (combination_i in 1 : nrow(ecosystem_combinations)) {
  
  for (time_point_i in 1:length(time_points)) {
    
    # Set parameters
    
    row_i = row_i + 1
    
    # Create ds_metaecosystems row
    
    ds_metaecosystems[[row_i]] = ds_ecosystems %>%
      filter(
        ecosystem_ID %in% c(
          ecosystem_combinations[combination_i, ]$ID_first_ecosystem,
          ecosystem_combinations[combination_i, ]$ID_second_ecosystem),
        time_point == time_points[time_point_i]) %>%
      
      # Calculate meta-ecosystem metrics
      
      group_by(time_point,
               day,
               ecosystem_size_ml,
               connection,
               disturbance_percentage) %>%
      summarise(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2 = sum(bioarea_tot_mm2)) %>%
      mutate(bioarea_mm2_per_ml = total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2 / (ecosystem_size_ml * 2),
             sqrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = sqrt(bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
             log_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = log(bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
             inv_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 1 / bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
             exp_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = exp(bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
             system_nr = ecosystem_combinations[combination_i, ]$system_nr,
             ecosystems_combined = ecosystem_combinations[combination_i, ]$ecosystems_combined) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
}

# Finish up ds_metaecosystems

ds_metaecosystems = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(!system_nr %in% metaecosystems_to_take_off,
         connection == "connected" | ecosystems_combined %in% unconnected_metaecosystems_selected)
```
